skill.name: project-scaffolder
skill.description: Creates coordinated Markdown scaffolding for self-learning resource projects. Generates plans, session tasks, personas, project context, and Claude instructions using structured templates.
skill.summary: Builds five aligned planning documents for structured learning resources.
skill.author: BitYoungjae

content.value_statement: Planning long learning resources requires coordinated outlines, tasks, personas, context, and project instructions. This skill generates five aligned Markdown documents from reusable templates.
actual_capabilities: Creates plan.md with parts, chapters, sections, learning goals, practice work, and page allocations.
Creates task.md with session boundaries, section checklists, progress metrics, and links to the plan.
Defines writer and reader personas, learning preferences, terminology policies, and domain guidance.
Records target environments, dependencies, reference sources, setup commands, and content freshness details.
Creates CLAUDE.md instructions for writing, validation, file naming, quality checks, and research priorities.
limitations: The skill targets self-learning resources and is not a general software application generator.
Users must provide project scope, audience, environment, language, and page targets.
Generated placeholders and setup commands require review before use.
The templates do not verify research accuracy, dependency safety, or completed document quality.

use_cases.title: Plan a technical tutorial
use_cases.description: Create an aligned outline, task schedule, audience profile, environment record, and Claude instructions for a new technical guide.

use_cases.title: Structure a course handbook
use_cases.description: Divide a long handbook into parts, chapters, sections, exercises, and manageable writing sessions.

use_cases.title: Coordinate AI-assisted documentation
use_cases.description: Establish shared project context, terminology, quality standards, and progress tracking before drafting begins.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic project scaffold
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a self-learning project about {TOPIC} for {TARGET_AUDIENCE}. Use {LANGUAGE} and target {TOTAL_PAGES} pages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup with essential project details

prompt_templates.title: Plan a technical learning guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Scaffold a guide about {TOPIC} for {TARGET_SYSTEM}. Include prerequisites, exercises, page allocations, and five writing sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Design an audience-specific curriculum
prompt_templates.prompt: Create all five planning documents for {TOPIC}. Define reader motivations, assumed knowledge, learning objectives, terminology policy, and measurable completion criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build a constrained documentation program
prompt_templates.prompt: Scaffold {TOPIC} for {AUDIENCE} within {TOTAL_PAGES} pages. Balance concepts, practice, and review while documenting dependencies, research priorities, and quality policies.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning with scope and governance constraints

output_examples.input: Create a 100-page beginner guide to container fundamentals for Linux users.
output: A plan divides the guide into foundations, daily workflows, and deployment topics.
A task list groups related sections into five writing sessions.
Persona, context, and Claude instruction documents share the same audience and environment.

output_examples.input: Plan an intermediate data visualization handbook for analysts.
output: The outline assigns pages to concepts, examples, exercises, and review.
The persona records analyst experience, goals, terminology, and preferred learning style.
The project context tracks tools, references, package versions, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Structure a bilingual onboarding guide with strict terminology rules.
output_examples.output: The scaffold aligns document language, first-use terminology, prohibited phrases, review checks, and session tasks across all five files.

best_practices: Provide concrete audience, platform, language, and page constraints before generation.
Review page totals and task links after changing the outline structure.
Validate every dependency, reference URL, and setup command before publishing or execution.
anti_patterns: Do not leave important placeholders unresolved in generated project files.
Do not execute generated setup commands without reviewing their source and effect.
Do not treat page estimates or research notes as verified facts.

faq.question: Which files does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates plan.md, task.md, persona.md, project-context.md, and CLAUDE.md.

faq.question: What projects fit these templates?
faq.answer: They fit tutorials, guides, handbooks, and other structured self-learning resources.

faq.question: Can it plan different audience levels?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates capture audience experience, assumed knowledge, motivations, and learning preferences.

faq.question: How are long projects divided?
faq.answer: The skill organizes content into parts, chapters, sections, and sessions with page targets.

faq.question: Does it research or validate the subject?
faq.answer: No. It records research priorities and references, but users must verify accuracy and freshness.

faq.question: Does it run generated setup commands?
faq.answer: No. The templates record commands as project context, and users should review them before execution.
